subject: Graduate Engineering Officer application, Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.company_line: Regional city Infrastructure Services team supporting roads, civil design, drafting, estimating and development engineering
letter.subject: Application: Graduate Engineering Officer (Ref 1348)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Engineering Officer role (Ref 1348) with the City of Greater Geraldton, listed on SEEK and closing at 4pm on 15 October 2026. The role supports Infrastructure Services on engineering investigations, roads, civil design, drafting, estimating and development engineering applications.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language, with road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge engineer at JustBuilt and as field engineer at Grand Travaux, including inspections, crew coordination, materials tracking and progress reports. My AutoCAD and Civil 3D experience to date is academic rather than commercial production drafting, and I have not yet used Main Roads WA standards on a paid job.

I live in Melton Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for regional work and open to discussing relocation to Geraldton.
I have attached my resume. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

checklist: Open www.cgg.wa.gov.au/employment/ from the SEEK link-out
Paste written responses to the six selection criteria (max 1250 characters each) using only facts.json claims
Confirm willingness for pre-employment medical including alcohol and other substances testing
Submit before 4pm Thursday 15 October 2026; phone Chris Edwards (08) 9956 6949 only if Marc wants a qualification discussion
notes: Portal pack only. Selection criteria responses to be drafted by Marc/Jeremie from facts; do not invent MRWA project experience.
